Priya (support): FYI customer X reporting huge latency spikes on our text-generate endpoint p99 ~ 3.2s vs usual ~0.6s. started ~2h ago. attaching snippet of their request and example trace.
Alex (eng-sre): can you paste the request id and region? also any error codes?
Priya (support): req-id: req_8f3c4a, region: us-west-2, no 5xxs in the customer's logs, just timeouts on client after 3s. customer says it affects their nightly batch.
OncallBot: ALERT: p99 latency > 2.0s (us-west-2, text-generate) for 120m. Current p50=0.12s, p95=0.45s, p99=2.8s.
Alex (eng-sre): thanks. first triage: check recent deploys and model routing changes. Li, any model or quantized variant rollouts in us-west-2?
Li (runtime): No model rollouts in the last 6h. We pushed a minor kernel tweak 3h ago to the serving pool (rollback window closed), but load hasn't spiked on system metrics. CPU on control-plane is fine.
Omar (infra): checking autoscaler logs and GPU pool. GPU utilization in us-west-2 up ~15% over baseline, but instance scale is normal. I see an increase in small concurrent requests from one tenant (tenant-x) — looks like a burst of many short requests.
Alex (eng-sre): that tenant might be overrunning our batching window and causing head-of-line blocking. mitigation plan: 1) enable circuit breaker for tenant-x to cap qps, 2) route tenant-x to fallback model (smaller variant) in another region if possible, 3) reduce max batching window from 40ms to 20ms for text-generate in us-west-2. Try one at a time, prefer low-risk first.
Li (runtime): I can push a route override to divert tenant-x to model `redwood-mini-1` (smaller, lower-latency) with immediate effect. Apply policy: weight=0.0 -> fallback model weight=1.0 for tenant-x. Command: `curl -X POST $CONTROL_PLANE/api/route-override -d '{"tenant":"tenant-x","route":{"model":"redwood-mini-1","weight":1}}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'`
Priya (support): Maya from customer-success is on the thread, asking if this will affect output quality. Maya: hi — customer prefers correctness but would accept slightly smaller model for heavy batches during their nightly window.
Maya (customer-success): they confirmed: switch to smaller model for the nightly window is acceptable, please keep them updated.
Alex (eng-sre): Li, after you apply the override, can you also push a temporary rate limit on tenant-x to 200 qps and enable 503 circuit-breaker at 90th percentile queue time? Example throttling rule (control-plane): `{"tenant":"tenant-x","limit":200,"window_ms":1000}`.
Li (runtime): applied route override and throttling rule. Also reduced batching window to 20ms for us-west-2 text-generate.
OncallBot: CONFIG CHANGE: route-override applied by Li at 2256789142. throttling rule applied.
Alex (eng-sre): monitoring — give it 3-5 mins and check p95/p99.
Priya (support): relayed to customer; they switched their nightly to start in 10m to test.
(Oncall pause ~4m)
Li (runtime): Initial numbers: p50=0.10s, p95=0.32s, p99=0.68s for us-west-2 after changes. Tenant-x now 70% on fallback model.
Omar (infra): no infra alerts. autoscaler stable. No error increase.
Maya (customer-success): customer reports much improved latency during their test window. thanks.
Alex (eng-sre): next steps: 1) keep overrides for 24h, monitor regressions and quality metrics, 2) prepare a targeted rollback plan if output quality complaints > threshold, 3) schedule a root-cause follow-up: check why tenant-x generated burst (client bug? misconfiguration?). Assign to Priya + Omar to get tenant logs; Li to review serving kernel tweak.
Priya (support): opening escalation ticket to tenant-x owner, requesting request-rate history and rollout notes.
Omar (infra): I'll dig into autoscaler and queue latency histograms; logging event: `investigate/2256789012` created.
Alex (eng-sre): Documentation note for playbook: when p99 regresses and is due to tenant burst/head-of-line: quick mitigations in order — 1) per-tenant route override to smaller model 2) per-tenant QPS throttling 3) reduce batching window for affected region 4) enable circuit-breaker to return 503 fast 5) route traffic to alternate region if still bad. Also verify rollback paths for any kernel changes.
Li (runtime): I'll add a guard in console: when p99 > 1.5s trigger a one-click mitigation panel with these actions.
Alex (eng-sre): If we see repeated incidents from same tenant, escalate to product to enforce client-side best practices (backoff, request coalescing).
Maya (customer-success): customer happy for now, asked for a short postmortem once RCA done.
Priya (support): closing loop with customer. will update the ticket when RCA done.
Alex (eng-sre): thanks team. leaving note: last_message_ts=2256789345 — close thread when postmortem created. :white_check_mark:
